page_title: The AI Workspace for People & Agents | monday.com

summary.name: monday.com
summary.one_liner: monday.com is a work management platform marketed as an AI Workspace where people and AI agents run business workflows together.
use_cases: Triaging IT tickets and escalating incidents
Scoring sales deals and automating follow-ups
Screening job applicants and scheduling interviews
Tracking project risks and updating stakeholders
Building custom AI agents for specific workflows
summary.what_it_does: The page describes monday.com as an AI workspace where people and agents handle work together. It offers prebuilt agent types for marketing, IT, product, sales, HR and project management (PMO), and lets teams build custom agents by defining a goal and rules. Governance features are listed: a real-time log of agent actions, per-agent data access and read/edit/create permissions, a simulation mode to validate actions before activation, and AI usage and spend tracking per team with limits and alerts. It states it connects to Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, Gemini, or any MCP-connected tool, and it says customer data is not used to train AI models.
notable: Open platform connecting agents from Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, Gemini, or any MCP-connected tool
Governance controls: agent activity log, per-agent data permissions, simulation mode, and AI spend limits
Prebuilt agents for marketing, IT, product, sales, HR and PMO, plus custom agent builder
Page claims recognition as a Leader in three Gartner Magic Quadrant reports
caveats: Page says Free plan is unlimited in time, but paid tiers and their pricing are not detailed on the page
Claims such as 'trusted by over 60% of the Fortune 500' and a 346% Forrester ROI figure are vendor-reported marketing claims
